blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Wednesday said the quote attributed to him by a news site lacked context and misidentified the event by which it was stated. They said the senator’s quote was supposed to refer to public trust, and not to accuse public servants. Cayetano’s camp issued the statement after an art card branded with the news site Pampanga Today attributed the quote “Lahat tayo magnanakaw, lahat kayo, lahat tayo magnanakaw sa gobyerno” to the senator’s Nov. 24 Facebook live.
